title: [backlog][csdlc-v3] Restore green proof, shadow, and install tests
body:
## Summary

The full C-SDLC v3 validation suite is not green. A focused v3 remote test pass succeeds, but `cargo test --locked --manifest-path csdlc-v3/Cargo.toml --all-targets` fails in the proof/shadow/install integration surface.

## Evidence

Observed in the v3 issue-creation repair worktree `/Volumes/FastWork/adl-worktrees/adl-v3-issue-creation-docs`:

```sh
cargo test --locked --manifest-path csdlc-v3/Cargo.toml --all-targets
```

Failures observed:

- `tests/proof_parity_install_commands.rs::install_route_is_one_binary_plan_gated_by_505` panicked with `blocked install must return nonzero`.
- `tests/proof_parity_install_commands.rs::proof_route_accepts_fresh_deterministic_manifest_only` failed with `shadow_output_not_json`.
- `tests/proof_parity_install_commands.rs::proof_route_retains_a_deterministic_native_receipt` failed with `shadow_output_not_json`.
- `tests/proof_parity_install_commands.rs::shadow_route_executes_real_typed_v2_and_v3_doctor_commands` failed with `shadow_output_not_json`.
- `tests/proof_parity_install_commands.rs::shadow_route_fails_closed_on_real_lifecycle_mismatch_and_provider_effects` expected `shadow_normalized_mismatch` but received `shadow_output_not_json`.

## Acceptance criteria

- `cargo test --locked --manifest-path csdlc-v3/Cargo.toml --all-targets` is green for the proof/shadow/install surfaces.
- Shadow route commands emit exactly one typed JSON document on stdout when the tests expect typed JSON.
- The install route's blocked/nonzero behavior is intentional, tested, and aligned with the command contract.
- Any generated fixture/evidence artifacts are either ignored intentionally or written to a deterministic test fixture location that does not dirty normal worktrees.

## Non-goals

- Do not weaken proof parity, shadow mismatch detection, or install authority gates to make the tests pass.
- Do not remove v2 code in this issue unless the v2-removal authority issue explicitly owns that work.
